arms_definition: baseline=depth4/min_leaf10/unit AJ/direct-parent strength10; time_w2/time_w4 only change case weights in leaf AND direct parent; leaf20 changes min_leaf10 to20 with unit AJ and same shrinkage. No combined arm.
population: unchanged first financial/audit ST, all nonfinancial sectors, 83 old-C inputs, next-open origins, announcement endpoints
step1_choices: Add12m as co-primary endpoint; retain independent companies. Recurrent ST and auxiliary endpoints deferred because they change risk sets/targets and require a separate source/transition audit; no duplicated companies masquerading as new events.
time_validation: For each outer year Y and entry cohort V=2019..2022 with V<Y, fit entries before V with all stops censored at V-01-01 minus1day, predict V entries; validation outcomes are capped at outer Y-01-01 minus1day. No entry cohort2023/2024 is used for parameter selection. Historic metadata/features are from the frozen training-only snapshots, with inherited PIT limits.
selection: Equal average of ensemble termination IPCW Brier over evaluable cohort-by-horizon cells (12 and24 months). Evaluable requires full endpoint knowledge or at least5 observations at risk at horizon; no flat-tail extrapolation. Select weight1/2/4 with lowest mean; ties within1e-12 choose smallest weight. Fixed leaf20 is reported separately, not combined with weighting or chosen by test results.
calibration_gate: For each outer year and horizon, use the latest historical validation entry cohort with complete endpoint knowledge; require at least10 distinct target events and10 other known outcomes, then inspect underestimation before any fitted logit. This necessary gate is not proof of adequate precision. No substitution of an older cohort just to pass. If gate fails, no calibration fit or amplification.
validation_reuse: Rolling fit/evaluation inputs must be elementwise identical between outer snapshots after historical censoring. Fit once per validation entry year and seed, then evaluate the same fixed predictions against each outer-cutoff label snapshot. Abort on input mismatch rather than silently reuse.
evaluation: AUC/AP, Brier, observed-minus-predicted risk, four risk bins, Top20/25 coverage, unknown outcomes; both causes/horizons; complete function reconstruction, curve constraints, unweighted and effective event support, leaf zeros, complexity and seed variation.
uncertainty: 500 company-bootstrap draws for training-only AJ, seed20261028; describes source-conditional uncertainty, not causal policy effects. Zero-event percentile intervals are degenerate and not proof of zero true risk. Three model seeds are not confidence intervals.
2025_status: SEALED_NO_NEW_EVALUATION; earlier post_st_train2024_h12_v1 receipt status COMPLETE proves previous exposure; independent evaluation unavailable, never relabel as unexecuted/blind.
resources: heteropool two-node CPU independent jobs, one thread per job, 4GiB address-space ceiling, NFS, managed cgroup affinity; no GPU or synchronous cross-node fit
privacy: Aggregate-only Git delivery; companies/models/raw thresholds/functions/individual forecasts remain private.
stop: No added weights, seeds, cutpoints, causes, horizons, repeated-ST training or2025 evaluation after seeing results. Preserve every task and old defaults.
